title: TriadicFrameworks MCP — Awareness Diagnostic
description: Defines the awareness diagnostic for the Frequency Layer (Unseen). Measures resonance presence, recognition, and responsiveness within oscillation fields.
note: Students may rename qmroot if extending the work; it is a lineage artifact for TriadicFrameworks and RTT.

diagnostic.name: awareness
diagnostic.purpose: Measure whether an oscillation is detected, recognized, and meaningfully responded to by the operator.

signalPresence.description: Measures whether an oscillation is present in the resonance field.

signalRecognition.description: Measures whether the operator correctly identifies the oscillation pattern.

signalResponsiveness.description: Measures how effectively the operator responds to the detected oscillation.

interactions.clarity: Awareness increases clarity by improving recognition of oscillation patterns.
interactions.alignment: Awareness supports alignment by ensuring the operator responds to the correct signal.
interactions.coherence: Awareness stabilizes coherence by reducing misinterpretation of oscillation.
interactions.drift: Low awareness increases drift by allowing unnoticed oscillation deviation.
interactions.regime: Awareness determines whether the oscillation is in detectable, transitional, or blind regime.

reality.details: Presence, recognition, and responsiveness are computed from operator interaction with the oscillation.

imagination.details: The unseen resonance field opens its eyes, perceiving the oscillation clearly and responding with precision.

information.details: Awareness is anchored to qmroot-0D and triad-frequency, ensuring consistent cosmological interpretation.
